result.title: Inside Cricket’s Smartest Backroom | Rajasthan Royals | ChatGPT @rajasthanroyals
result.description:
What gives one of cricket’s smartest teams its edge before the first ball is bowled?

Go behind the scenes with Rajasthan Royals as Kumar Sangakkara and the franchise’s analytics and technology teams reveal how ChatGPT and OpenAI tools support auction strategy, player analysis, match preparation, and creative work across the organization.

result.title: Computer History in ChatGPT
result.description:
Codex & ChatGPT can now understand the context around what you’re working on.

When you opt in to Computer History, it can help you pick up where you left off, get back to unfinished projects, and see suggested skills or scheduled tasks based on the work you do regularly.

Available in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac for ChatGPT Pro, Business, and Enterprise.

If you’re on a Business or Enterprise team, your admin will need to turn it on first.

result.title: Get a daily CFO briefing with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
Start the day with a clear view of the decisions that matter most.

ChatGPT Work brings financial performance, close status, contract risks, and market signals into one CFO briefing. See what changed, identify emerging opportunities, and prioritize decisions across the business.

When a potential acquisition surfaces, ChatGPT creates an executive decision memo and an editable Excel workbook covering valuation, financial projections, transaction economics, and risk.

See how ChatGPT Work can help your finance team:
https://openai.com/business/solutions/finance/

result.title: Build custom financial forecasting apps with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
Build an interactive financial forecast using the numbers your business already trusts.

ChatGPT Work connects approved financial data from Google Drive and NetSuite, compares actuals with the latest outlook, and creates an interactive forecasting dashboard. Adjust assumptions, test scenarios, and see how different decisions could affect the business.

Approved figures, proposed adjustments, and hypothetical scenarios stay clearly separate.

result.title: Reconcile quarter-end financials with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
Prepare for quarter-end close with a clear view of what changed and why.

ChatGPT Work connects board materials in Google Drive with posted financial data in NetSuite. It flags variances, traces discrepancies to their source, shows the impact on the forecast, and prepares a close recommendation for Finance to review.

When items need attention, ChatGPT turns them into an action plan in Slack with clear owners and next steps.
